title: Cross-Domain Real-Data Score Transfer - ICAR-16 Cognitive Ability
status: FROZEN_AND_APPROVED - single locked execution approved by the project owner on 2026-08-07; no METER or MIRT outcome had been computed at approval time

amendment_1_provenance_clarification.authorized_by: project owner, as part of the approval; no change to the sample rule, item set, factor map, model, comparator, gates, adequacy routing, or verdict language
amendment_1_provenance_clarification.clarification: the ICAR-16 administration subgroup is RECONSTRUCTED from the exact 16-item response pattern because no form indicator is distributed with the data; its validity is independently supported by the exact n=4,574 match to the published Sample-Test administration group

scientific_question: Can the same frozen METER model reproduce separately fitted multidimensional factor scores on a COGNITIVE ability battery - the ICAR-16 with its four documented item domains - a construct domain entirely outside personality and quality of life?

dataset.distribution: Selected ICAR data from the SAPA-Project (Condon & Revelle), item responses collected 2010-08-18 through 2013-05-20 via SAPA random-subset administration
dataset.provenance: published data paper: Condon & Revelle, 'Selected ICAR Data from the SAPA-Project: Development and Initial Validation of a Public-Domain Measure', Journal of Open Psychology Data (10.5334/jopd.25); deposit doi:10.7910/DVN/AD9RVY (Harvard Dataverse, 2015-09-23)

licence.determination: CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication - stated in the published data paper for this exact deposit; recorded ONCE per the standing governance rule; no AI-use, redistribution or commercial-use restriction exists under CC0
licence.external_consistency: the paper describes ~97,000 respondents and 60 items (9 LN, 11 MR, 16 VR, 24 R3D) collected 18aug2010-20may2013 - all three match this file's census exactly (N=96,958; identical item-type counts; the filename's date range)

dataset.file_immutability: the downloaded CSV is never modified; the runner binds to the hash and byte size (snapshot-binding guard); accompanying documentation is EXTERNAL (no codebook ships with the CSV): the psychTools ability/iqitems documentation and the published papers serve as the instrument documentation of record
dataset.role_predeclaration: cross-domain score-transfer evaluation - single role, single run, evaluated once

item_mapping.instrument: ICAR-16 Sample Test (International Cognitive Ability Resource; Condon & Revelle 2014, Intelligence 46:52-64)
item_mapping.verification: DOUBLY verified, never from memory: (1) the published key in the psychTools 'ability'/'iqitems' documentation lists the sample test as reasoning 4/16/17/19, letters 7/33/34/58, matrix 45/46/47/55, rotate 3/4/6/8 with the four lower-order factors named; (2) the dataset's own administration structure shows exactly ONE high-frequency intact 16-item pattern (n=4,574 among 12,600 distinct 16-item patterns) and it is precisely this set with 4/4/4/4 domain composition. Both verifications agree 16/16.
item_mapping.coding: items arrive PRE-SCORED dichotomous: 0 incorrect, 1 correct (verified within the subgroup: value set exactly {0,1}); canonical categories 0..1; 2 response categories, inside METER's trained support (2-6); no recode direction exists for correct/incorrect items
item_mapping.missing: 'NA' cells -> missing; within the analytic subgroup no missing item exists by construction (see sample definition)

sample_definition.administration_design: SAPA random subsets of the 60-item pool; the distribution carries NO form/administration variable, so administered-but-skipped items are indistinguishable from unadministered items
sample_definition.documented_icar16_administration_n: not separately documented in the distribution; identified structurally as below
sample_definition.inclusion_rule_frozen: a respondent is in the analytic subgroup if and only if their ANSWERED item set is EXACTLY the 16-item ICAR-16 Sample Test set - the unique high-frequency intact pattern. 'Any 16 observed responses' is explicitly REJECTED as the rule: 37,036 respondents have 16 answered items but all except this pattern are random draws (12,599 other distinct 16-item patterns).
sample_definition.ambiguous_exclusions: 1,084 respondents answered a nonempty PROPER subset of the ICAR-16 set; they may be form-takers with skips or random-draw respondents - unidentifiable without an administration variable - and are excluded BY DESIGN, recorded here prospectively
sample_definition.sparse_boundary: the subgroup is dense by construction (all 16 items answered by every included respondent), honoring the sparse-unsupported boundary; every partial administration is excluded
sample_definition.weights: unweighted; gender/age columns are not read

model.rule: the bit-identical M8B METER model, reproduced from frozen seeds and hash-asserted; no retraining, no calibration, no ICAR-specific fitting of any kind; K=4 and 2 categories inside trained support; 4 items per factor is a recorded transfer condition
model.phi_status: Phi is descriptive only, remains NOT SUPPORTED, and cannot become supported through D9D

comparator.specification: the frozen confirmatory mirt specification at K=4 (pairwise COV, graded itemtype - dichotomous fits as 2-category graded, i.e. 2PL - QMCEM, NCYCLES 2000 TOL 1e-4, one MHRM retry then recorded nonconvergence, EAP with QMC, NA full-information), fitted to the identical scored 16-item matrix of the analytic subgroup
comparator.timeout: 3600 s under the repaired whole-tree enforcement

comparator_adequacy_routing_rule.rule: nonconvergence OR an inadmissible/non-distinguishable comparator solution routes MECHANICALLY to D9D_NOT_EVALUABLE - never to scientific FAIL
inadmissible_defined_numerically: nonconvergence under the frozen specification (one MHRM retry included)
any comparator factor-correlation |value| >= 0.95 (a live risk for g-saturated cognitive domains, named prospectively)
comparator factor-correlation matrix not positive definite
any comparator factor with EAP score variance below 1e-4
comparator_adequacy_routing_rule.prohibited_responses: no item substitution, no domain merging, no residual correlations, no mapping change, no bifactor rescue, no alternative ICAR form - before or after outcomes

guards.snapshot_binding: execution binds to the hashed CSV exactly (sha256 + byte size); any change to the file is a refusal, never a re-hash
guards.deterministic_alignment: no permutation exists (factor k vs factor k, both anchored to the frozen mapping); each side's factor signs aligned INDEPENDENTLY against that side's own proportion-correct composites; flips recorded; gate correlations SIGNED, computed after alignment; no absolute value in the gate path

gates.rule: ALL-OR-NOTHING at the frozen criteria; pure adjudication function pinned by test before the run; no 'close enough', no domain-specific exception, no post-outcome gate change

primary.no_collapse_nan_degeneracy: the D9B numeric definitions: no model |Phi_ij| >= 0.95, no factor score variance below 1e-4, no NaN agreement

verdicts_pre_frozen.D9D_PASS: every primary gate passes: METER's factor scores transfer to a cognitive ability battery, reproducing separately fitted confirmatory scores on the intact ICAR-16 administration subgroup at the prespecified operating point - with all prior scope disclosures carried in the record.
verdicts_pre_frozen.D9D_FAIL: any primary gate fails: cross-domain score transfer to cognitive ability at the prespecified operating point is not established; the supported claim remains scoped as before; the model is not tuned against ICAR afterward.
verdicts_pre_frozen.D9D_NOT_EVALUABLE: the comparator-adequacy routing rule fired; no claim either way; re-charter required.

orchestrator_boundary: rows read by code only; aggregates only; every tabulated count below 10 suppressed as '<10'; no participant-level value in prompts, logs, reports or commits (the counts and value-set facts recorded above are administration-structure aggregates, not outcomes)
stop_condition: no METER-MIRT agreement outcome is computed until this charter is explicitly approved
